title: DBI Backend for Trino
text: Connects HTTP HTTPS probes /v1/info, bad address rejected credential fails dbConnect() rather first query. Follows Trino’s nextUri pagination, handles every state protocol can report (QUEUED, PLANNING, RUNNING, FINISHED, FAILED, CANCELED). Maps Trino types R types without losing precision: BIGINT comes back exact bit64::integer64 default, DOUBLE bit bit, timestamps microsecond. Reports rows statement changed dbExecute(), accepts table names strings, DBI::Id() quoted identifiers. Writes data frames dbWriteTable(), dbAppendTable() dbCreateTable(), renames drops tables dbRenameTable() dbRemoveTable(). dbWriteTable(overwrite = TRUE) renames existing table instead dropping , puts back write fails. Wraps statements Trino transactions dbBegin(), dbCommit(), dbRollback() dbWithTransaction(). Cancels query server result cleared still running. Bounds HTTP request timeout, query’s run time cluster query_max_run_time. Authenticates basic credentials, bearer JWT OAuth2 client credentials — held closure, never global variable — refuses send plain HTTP. Trusts internal certificate authority without turning verification . Translates dplyr pipelines Trino SQL dbplyr (>= 2.6.0) installed, expression computes Trino computes R.
